title: Calibration Department Definition: Start of the Lost Calibration Days (Rental Vehicle Coordination Courtesy)
content:
**Definition.** For network courtesy days on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental, the courtesy days are worked out from the lost calibration days. The lost calibration days are counted on the calibration order between a start and the window's closing date: where the order's first in-house attempt failed and the order was sublet to a dealer, they run from that first attempt to the window's closing date; where the first in-house attempt failed and a later in-house attempt passed, they run from the first attempt to the passing attempt; otherwise they run from the order's opening date to the window's closing date.

Each count is the difference between the two dates, in calendar days.

## Records read

The calibration order under ADAS Sensor Calibrations opened for the insurance claim repair order the rental is for: its opening date, its first in-house attempt with its date and result, any later passing attempt with its date, and its dealer sublet.

## Start and end by what the order shows

| Order's first in-house attempt | Later on the order | Lost calibration days run |
|---|---|---|
| Failed | Sublet to a dealer | From the first attempt to the window's closing date |
| Failed | Not sublet; a later in-house attempt passed | From the first attempt to the passing attempt |
| Passed, or no attempt yet, or any other case | | From the order's opening date to the window's closing date |

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates)

- Order opened on the 2nd, first attempt failed on the 4th, sublet on the 6th, window closing on the 12th: 8 lost calibration days.
- Order opened on the 2nd, first attempt failed on the 4th, second attempt passed on the 7th: 3 lost calibration days.
- Order opened on the 2nd, first attempt passed on the 5th, window closing on the 5th: 3 lost calibration days.
